catalog.note: R1 — canonical Music Work catalog. One work, many versions; TearScore picks the best version for the current context. `available:false` marks a version that is planned but not yet produced.

compatibilityClasses.A: Fully adaptive — stems, intro, loop, tier map, apex, outro. Safe anywhere.
compatibilityClasses.B: Adaptive radio edit — entry, loopable body, grouped stems, basic intensity. Safe for normal combat/Endless.
compatibilityClasses.C: Linear OST — full authored song, no gameplay loop contract. Archive/menu/replay/Album Mode.
compatibilityClasses.D: Stinger/moment — intro, victory, boss arrival, outro. Never general gameplay music.

canonical-ost.status: Source-preserved full mix, mastered. The earlier reconstructed version (Latin reprise fusion) was rejected by the owner and reverted 2026-07-25.

bossIntro.note: latin groove; plays once when the boss fight begins
